_comment: Merge the mcpServers block into ~/.claude.json (the top-level single-file state, NOT ~/.claude/settings.json). Replace 'mac-host' with the Tailscale MagicDNS hostname of the macOS machine that runs ios_device_mcp.py.
_v0_8_note: ios-device v0.8.0-alpha supports multiple iOS/iPadOS devices on one macOS host. You still add ONE entry here; the server routes per call via the 'device' parameter (alias or UDID). Single-device users: omit 'device' — auto-routed when only one device is connected.
_recommended_install: Use scripts/install-agent-side.py --platform ios-device --hostname <MAC_HOST_HOSTNAME> instead of editing this file by hand.
_transport_note: Uses streamable-http (type: 'http'). Same transport as android-device since v0.6.0. Endpoint path is /mcp.
_wda_note: WebDriverAgent must be built and running on each iOS device (via Xcode) BEFORE tools work. This MCP entry is server-side only. See docs/platforms/ios.md for WDA setup.
